gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-carlito: Expressive from the first stroke, Funnel Display looks drawn with a single marker. The tension with Carlito is what lingers: a modern sans whose tight spacing and modest capitals rein the heading in.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-courier-prime: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes, all of them the same width. Courier Prime, a monospace whose lowercase fills most of the height, would read steadily across many lines, like a drafting pen at work.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-fragment-mono: Expressive, Funnel Display bends spaghetti-like strokes into letters. Fragment Mono, a monospace with a tall waist line and letters set like nails on a ruler, keeps the order while the heading does the talking.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-geist-mono: Funnel Display is commanding and spaghetti-like, every stroke the same width. Geist Mono, a monospace with big side gaps, reads in an orderly, unhurried, code-like rhythm across page after page.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hammersmith-one: Hammersmith One is a sans-serif of rounded, cord-cut strokes, its capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Funnel Display adds spaghetti-like strands on top, and the two fit together snugly.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-jaldi: Funnel Display holds a constant stroke from top to baseline, spaghetti-like and expressive. Jaldi, a sans with a gaping c and an x-height pushed high, keeps long reading moving along.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-krona-one: Expressive Funnel Display looks traced with one marker, every stroke the same width. Krona One, a sans-serif with loosely spaced, cast-iron-tall lowercase, makes extended reading feel sturdy and unhurried.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-menbere: Menbere, a plain sans, stacks tall lowercase like rolled cord, while Funnel Display bends thin steel rod into every letter. Menbere keeps paragraphs moving smoothly, line after line, without ever drawing attention.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mitr: Bent-rope lines make Funnel Display unmistakable, with every stroke the same width. Mitr, a sans-serif with hardly any gap between lowercase and capitals, handles the rest once the heading's big, short moment passes.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mukta-mahee: Stencil-cut letters of one steady width define Funnel Display. Its chunky, tall partner Mukta Mahee, a plain sans, gives that thin line a sturdy, approachable footing, and that difference is the real draw.
